title: IGoR model document
description: A recombination model: its structure, the template library, its parameters and its error rate. Every section is optional here: a reader requires the ones it reads. A document holding only its version and its parameters is a fragment, which a marginals file is. Schema version 0.3 is a pre-release one: no reader keeps support for it once the next exists.

$schema.description: The schema this document follows, for editors.

schema_version.description: The version of this schema the document follows.

engine_hints.description: What an engine may follow and the model does not mean.

event_order.description: The legacy engine's event list, every event once: it breaks ties of priority, and lays out the legacy marginals. Without it, events come in nickname order.
